author: Veli Raiya
title: Fantasy map designer and character illustrator wanted
content: Looking for a fantasy book map designer + character illustrator! Definitely doesn’t have to be the same artist for both. Bonus points if you’re a fantasy author recommending someone you’ve personally worked with. See the next posts for more details. Follow-ups: character art preferred as realistic, epic fantasy concept art (open to other styles); portraits for now, more if the style fits the series; bonus for POC and a wide variety of ethnicities. Map should be detailed and immersive with a classic fantasy-map feel, style open. Contact: reply on the thread or DM @veliraiyawrites.

author: blekek.k
title: Illustrators wanted for trading card project
content: Hi warga threads! We're looking for illustrators for our little trading card project. Whether you draw professionally, as a hobby, are still a student, or already work full-time, feel free to reach out. We're looking for artists that draws anime/manga style illustrations, cartoon/semi-cartoon illustration, Pokemon / One Piece / MTG TCG artwork, semi-realistic illustrations, and any other art styles. Comment if you're interested or DM me directly! Follow-up: author is reviewing portfolios and asked people who have not sent one to share a link to previous work. Contact: comment or DM @blekek.k.

author: Bee (Shel)
title: Paid character and concept art for fantasy series
content: ARTISTS + ANIMATORS OF THREADS! I’m a writer developing an adult fantasy animated series and I’m looking for artists to help bring it to life! I’m starting small, but this is paid work. I’m looking to commission character/concept art first and grow from there. Fantasy artists/animators—drop your work + rates!! Follow-up (not closed): author was overwhelmed by responses and said they are still early and figuring out funding and budgeting, and planned more posts about the show. Contact: comment with work and rates or DM @bee.chaoticcore.
